lines.en: 'It's no fun when none of them fight back.'

Michael smoked as he surveyed the corpses strewn across the battlefield. Billowing gray smoke. Cigarettes made by the artisans of the second generation. One reason Michael enjoyed hunting demons and taking excursions was that he could smoke his beloved cigarettes to his heart's content.
In Eden, smoking was 'Evil.'
After smoking several cigarettes in succession on the spot, Michael ground one out against the flesh of a corpse and thought.
'Has it been too long?'
「Too long? This is only the beginning.」
Michael frowned at the voice echoing in his head.
'Shut up.'
「Hurry up and awaken me. Set me free.」
Michael took out a fresh cigarette.
A Story's voice that he had been hearing for a very long time. Whenever he heard that voice, Michael could not help lighting up.
'It isn't time yet.'
Michael inhaled the cigarette smoke deeply.
[A new revelation has been issued by the nebula <Eden>.]
[Archangel hunting. How intriguing.]
After hearing my plan, Asmodeus smiled, baring white teeth.
[And not just any archangel, but the 'Savior of Corruption'······ Are you serious?]
“Of course.”
[But aren't you on friendly terms with <Eden>? Do this, and you'll make enemies of them.]
“I don't care. I'm a 'Demon King' anyway.”
Here, I had to at least talk that way. I was trying to persuade Asmodeus, of all people.
In fact, Asmodeus seemed to be giving it considerable thought.

“Think about it. You need the Korean syllable block [won], don't you? You could get an archangel's Story into the bargain. 「One Who Hunted a Great Archangel.」 Doesn't the thought alone give you a thrill?”
But Asmodeus was not so easily won over.
Instead, a gaze that seemed to probe my intentions.
I decided it was time to make a bigger move.
“How disappointing. I thought a member of the 'Gourmet Association' like you would be different from other constellations.”
Asmodeus's brow twitched sharply at my words.
[Your understanding of the Demon King 'Asmodeus' increases greatly.]
[Your understanding of this individual is considerably high.]
[Activating Stage 2 of 'Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint'!]
It was a message I had never heard before.
At last, my proficiency in 'Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint' had grown enough to let me see into the minds of some constellations.
And the next moment, I began to hear Asmodeus's inner thoughts.
「How utterly insolent, Demon King of Salvation.」
An inner world like a clinging swamp.
Listening to the thoughts behind that languorous gaze made my stomach turn.
The thoughts continued.
「A trap I find so tempting······.」
As expected, Asmodeus had not become a 'candidate for the next Great Demon King' for nothing.
He had already realized that my proposal was a trap.
「The Demon King of Salvation's target is probably the 'Savior of Corruption.'」
「He intends to use me and the other constellations to hunt Michael, then take his modifier necklace.」
「It's rather admirable that he's using his head, but his cheek makes me reluctant to let it slide.」
Asmodeus's expression gradually chilled.
It seemed that this much persuasion was not enough after all.
「Michael is a troublesome angel to face. Even under the second generation's probability restrictions······.」
Asmodeus's conflicting thoughts were finally settling on a course. A faint killing intent seeping from his long nails.
I felt Anna Croft tense beside me and ready herself for combat. Perhaps she had seen something through [Future Sight].
But I was not worried.
It was about time for something her [Future Sight] could not observe to happen.
Then, in the next instant, a strange expression came over Asmodeus's face.
Asmodeus's briefly frozen expression gave way to a complex mix of emotions. Eyes that seemed to be reading something in empty air.
How much time had passed? Asmodeus's eyes, flickering with countless emotions, turned toward me.
[Hehe, goodness······ The will of the <Star Stream> is truly inscrutable.]
“······What do you mean?”
[Just talking to myself. Very well. I'll accept your proposal. Let's give 'archangel hunting' a try.]
At Asmodeus's declaration, Anna Croft's eyes widened beside me. She looked utterly at a loss.
Regardless, Asmodeus smacked his lips and busily sent messages to someone. Probably communicating with the other 'Seekers of the End.'
Then someone's message sounded inside my head as well.
「(I did well, didn't I?)」
'Yes. Thank you, Sangah-ssi.'
The reason for Asmodeus's change of heart.
He had probably just read a 'revelation.'
More precisely, a 'false revelation' that Yoo Sangah and I had forged and spread.
「The fallen archangel shall die by the sword of a 'Sword Master' on the island of the aged Forgotten People.」
“······Another revelation?”
The Bureau, too, was thrown into turmoil by news of the new revelation.
The sales department was the first to feel its effects.
“Sales of 'Sword Master' skills have suddenly skyrocketed!”
“Replenish the skill stock! Contact the subcontractors and tell them to speed up conversion of mass-produced stigmas into skills!”
“B-but we still don't have enough stock!”
“Damn it······ Where have all the Story makers gone? Ah! What's his name? If we ask the 'Mass Production Maker'―”
Bihyung watched the situation unfold amid the chaos.
Beside him, the great dokkaebi 'Baram' spoke.
[Bihyung, open a new scenario.]
“······I already have.”
A message was appearing on the broad scenario surveillance screen.
[Sub-scenario ― 'Archangel Hunting' has begun!]
Constellations who had been hiding throughout the forests and plains could be seen converging somewhere. They had just bought 'Sword Master' Stories through the [Dokkaebi Bag].
“Are we allowed to open a scenario like this? <Eden> will object.”
[We already have the Scribe's consent. He said it doesn't matter. Payment has already been made, so there's nothing to worry about.]
“Allowing his own angel to be used as scenario material······ Hardly what you'd expect from the leader of Absolute Good.”
[That is how 'Absolute Good' has always been. It sometimes tramples lesser Good for the sake of a greater Good.]
“I know that, but lately it's become even harder to understand.”
[What has?]
“What are <Eden> and the Demon Realm thinking? Agreeing to the 'Great War of Saints and Demons' scenario now, of all times······ Won't that destroy all of them together?”
Baram regarded Bihyung with an unreadable gaze, then gave a quiet chuckle.
[There is a saying. Life is short, art is long.]
“A saying from Earth.”

[Yes. Words venerating the eternity of stories. But as you know, they're a lie. However magnificent a Story may be, it will die someday. Human life is simply absurdly short compared to a Story's lifespan.]
Baram's tone held the regrets of many long years. The voice of a dokkaebi who had spent a very long time telling the stories of constellations.
[Did you know? Once, there was no story in this <Star Stream> without a framework of 'Good and Evil.']
“I know.”
[And what about now?]
On the screen, the screams of constellations dying by Michael's sword rang out.
And there were constellations voyeuristically watching the battle.
Constellations sponsoring someone, hurling abuse, or enjoying themselves. Coins changed hands, and screams of pleasure and despair swept through them.
And in that spectacle, no one spoke of Good or Evil.
In that brief sigh, Bihyung finally grasped the great dokkaebi's wisdom. Baram spoke.
[This is a war to keep from disappearing.]
For two days, I prepared for the hunt with Anna Croft.
Asmodeus did not stay with us.
[Midnight, two days from now. See you at the hunting ground.]
He had left with only those words. He was probably making his own preparations to hunt an angel.
Now there were thirty minutes until midnight. The site agreed upon for the 'archangel hunt' was the 'Fertile Forest' in the island's north.
Just before we reached the forest, Anna Croft asked.
“Do you really think we can do this?”
“You're going to help me.”
“Even I can't predict every [future]. You should already know that.”
“Reading the short-term future will be enough for now.”
Short-term variables were all I needed to avoid.
And 'Anna Croft's' [Future Sight] was a skill well suited to avoiding such variables.
“······What will you do if I betray you? What if my 'target' is you―”
“I know it isn't.”
To begin with, I could not be Anna Croft's target.
She had entered the scenario before me.
Anna Croft narrowed her eyes and asked.
“······By the way, when did you decide to start speaking informally to me?”
“Now that you mention it, I did. ······Shall I go back to speaking politely?”
“Stop it. You're being revolting.”
“Incidentally, how many more times can you use [Future Sight] today?”
After glaring at me in disbelief, Anna Croft answered.
“Three times.”
“Please don't waste them. Use it when I give you the signal.”
“Why should I listen to―”
“Because this damned scenario won't end unless you listen to me.”
In the distance, constellations and incarnations screamed.
The hunt had already begun.
With a dreadful explosion, the lofty archangel's True Voice shook the entire forest.
[You dare use me as material for a 'scenario'?]
Anna Croft and I hid in the nearby undergrowth and peered at the battlefield.
Asmodeus was nowhere to be seen yet. Instead, almost every participant remaining on Island 3 had gathered in the 'Fertile Forest.'
Most were constellations aligned with 'Evil' or 'Neutrality.' There were many Historical-grade constellations, and a lower-ranked Demon King was also present.
Belial, 'Darkness of No Value,' from the 68th Demon Realm.
He seemed to have come at Asmodeus's summons.
He and every one of the other constellations held a second-generation longsword.
[Attack!]
Michael erupted in anger as the constellations charged with Belial at their head.
[A mere lower-ranked Demon King······ You must have all gone mad.]
After blasting Belial away with a terrifying gust, Michael unleashed his Status and erected a barrier of wind.
But some of them cut through the barrier and charged.
[The constellation 'Effort Expert' activates the skill 'Mass-Produced Sword Aura'!]
The same skill activated simultaneously in the participants' longswords.
Waves of sword aura, brilliant yellow or blue, advanced through Michael's Status.
Michael scoffed.
[······Ether Blade? You lunatics.]
The revelation I had leaked through Yoo Sangah was forged. Naturally, no 'Sword Master' could possibly kill the archangel Michael.
But just because the revelation was false did not mean it was complete nonsense without a chance of coming true.
Tzzzzzzzt!
[The second generation's probability grants a powerful buff to a particular skill!]
[Sword Aura], now disparaged as something used only by Transcendents.
But once, within the second generation's world setting, Sword Aura had been the strongest skill.
[It's working! Keep cutting!]
Sssssss!
Michael's wind barrier was gradually melting under the barrage of sword aura.
Just as the flustered Michael tried to activate a new Story, a flash of pitch-black ether cut across the air.
Shraaaak!
A seemingly magical line that appeared to slice through space itself.
A Demon King's long nail marks remained across the crumbling barrier.
[I've always wondered. Can an archangel still fly without its wings?]
Michael's torn wing struggled to move in the air.
Asmodeus smiled amid the drifting feathers.
[Now I have my answer. An archangel's ability to fly has nothing to do with whether it has wings.]
[······Asmodeus!]

Consumed by madness, Michael unleashed a barrage of Magic Power at Asmodeus. But the damage to his incarnation body had upset his balance, and he began wasting power without finding the right point to strike.
Asmodeus, meanwhile, used the constellations to inflict more and more damage on Michael.
As expected of Asmodeus.
It was a battle I could not help admiring.
“Let's join in. At this rate, we'll lose the Myth-grade Story to that Demon King.”
“Not yet.”
Anna Croft looked bewildered at my calm reply.
Having yet to use today's [Future Sight], she would not know.
What was about to happen, that is.
[The Story 'Evil That Destroys Evil' begins its storytelling.]
A pitch-black aura gathered around Michael's entire body like a flower bud.
A tainted aura so intense it was hard to believe it belonged to an archangel.
「That Good (善) chose the path of Evil to destroy Evil.」
Realizing something was wrong, the constellations launched a fierce assault, but could not put so much as a scratch on the black bud.
The bud absorbed their power as though feeding on nutrients, then slowly began to bloom.
[The archangel Michael is falling into corruption!]
Watching that overwhelming sight, I recalled a passage from 'Ways of Survival.'
「The constellations of this world are not all divided simply into 'constellations' and 'Demon Kings.' There is just one being who can wield the powers of both a constellation and a Demon King.」
In <Eden>'s ancient history, the first being to eat a Star Relic Fruit.
「No demon who beheld his true body survived.」
Rrrrrumble!
Something was awakening in the darkness.
Pitch-black wings. Horns that marked a Demon King.
[The Demon King 'King of Corrupted Angels' gazes upon the battlefield.]
King of Corrupted Angels.
That was the modifier of the archangel Michael when he became a Demon King.
Kwoooosh!
With a single casual gesture, he swept away every Evil-aligned constellation.
Even among demons (魔), there were different leagues. This was the true power of 'Michael,' a Myth-grade archangel.
Even Asmodeus's expression had frozen.
[This······ wasn't in the revelation.]
Then Michael's Status poured out, sending several Demon Kings flying.
Asmodeus's incarnation body also staggered, seemingly struck by a tremendous impact.
I sprang to my feet.
“Now.”
“You want to go in now?”
“Yes.”
“······Didn't you just see that? Even if that archangel is your target―”
“Why do you think my target is the 'archangel'?”
Anna Croft blinked blankly at my words.
[Great Demon's Eyes] were glowing red.
“Don't tell me······?”
In the distance, I saw Asmodeus sent flying like a kite with its string cut.
I had never had the slightest intention of facing the fallen archangel.
And an archangel was not the only one who possessed a Myth-grade Story.
[Your target modifier is 'Devil of Lust and Wrath.']
As the message appeared in the air, I drew my sword and spoke.
“Now, let's go get ourselves a Myth-grade Story.”
Anna Croft and I headed straight onto the battlefield.
Consumed by madness, Michael was tearing the surrounding constellations and incarnations to death.
An Evil born solely to destroy Evil.
In pure combat ability, the fallen angel Michael was no less formidable than Poseidon or Hades.
[A considerable number of constellations are watching events on 'Middle Island 3'!]
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' watches you anxiously.]
Constellations who had already reached the Main Island, or had not yet entered the 'Great War of Saints and Demons,' turned their attention here one by one.
As we began to enter Michael's range, Anna Croft spoke.
“It's dangerous to go any closer. My [Covert Operations] skill can't······.”
I caught Anna Croft by the wrist.
[The Story 'The Stone and I' begins its story!]
[The Story 'The Stone and I' is puzzled by 'Anna Croft's' presence.]
“Please take care of this woman too.”
[The Story 'The Stone and I' looks at you with slight displeasure.]
[The Story 'The Stone and I' has shared its effects with 'Anna Croft.']
We strode boldly across the battlefield.
Michael and the other constellations had not noticed us. To their eyes, we probably looked like two stones rolling across the ground.
Anna Croft asked in surprise.
“What is this Story?”
“A Story that turns you into a stone.”
With no time to explain, that was all I said.
Constellations' corpses lay along every path through the battlefield. Now and then, I saw one still alive.
Belial, 'Darkness of No Value,' Demon King of the 68th Demon Realm.
Struck by Michael's attack, he could barely hold himself upright as Stories streamed from him.
Come to think of it, this one had been after me too.
Shhk!
I calmly drove [Unbreakable Faith] into his body.
[You have defeated the Demon King of the 68th Demon Realm!]
[This Demon King is ranked below you. Your ranking does not change.]
[You have acquired the modifier necklace 'Darkness of No Value.']
[You have killed five Demon King incarnation bodies.]
[The possibility of a new attribute opens to you!]
“You're a Demon King yourself. Are you allowed to just kill them like that?”
“Then I'll quit being a Demon King.”
Anna Croft looked dumbfounded as I spoke so nonchalantly.
Rrrrrumble!
Behind us came the sound of Michael's Status running wild. If the second generation's probability had been even a little weaker, that power would have blown away the entire forest.
“We don't have time. Let's hurry. Asmodeus should be in much the same state.”
Fragments of a Demon King's Stories lay just off the forest path. Traces of a high-ranking Demon King incomparable to Belial. It was obvious whose they were.
After pushing through the undergrowth for a while, I saw a figure leaning against a great old tree.
[······You came after all.]
Asmodeus smiled as though he had known I would come.
With one arm and one leg severed from his incarnation body and its chest utterly crushed, he was barely clinging to life.
[To think Michael possessed the power of 'corruption'······ You knew from the beginning, didn't you?]
Asmodeus looked as though he finally understood everything.
[And now you'll take my necklace.]
“Yes.”
Asmodeus's modifier necklace glittered, flipped over. If I came to own every block on that necklace, Asmodeus would be eliminated from this 'Great War of Saints and Demons.'
[Then get it over with.]
Asmodeus's incarnation body was that of a girl who looked about sixteen. Even if I killed this incarnation body, Asmodeus's true body would not die.
But this incarnation body would certainly die.
And this incarnation body was Manager Han Myungoh's daughter.
“I won't kill you. We'll make a deal instead.”
[A deal? What sort of deal, at this point?]
“Transfer one Myth-grade Story to me. Then I won't eliminate you from the scenario.”
Asmodeus burst into loud laughter. Blood gushed from his mouth.
[What an amusing idea. Are you threatening me?]
“That's right.”
For a moment, tension hung between Asmodeus and me. A faint sigh passed through his eyes as he stared at me.
[You've become a perfect 'Demon King' now. Not one of the seventy-two could deny that you're a Demon King.]
“Thanks for the compliment.”
[But there's a problem with your proposal. I'm your target. How exactly do you intend to avoid eliminating me?]
“You aren't eliminated unless every block is taken from you. I'll leave you one.”
The block I intended to leave him was [ui]. I happened to have a spare. Asmodeus spoke.
[I'm so grateful I could cry.]
I reached for his modifier necklace.
The syllables began passing over from Asmodeus's necklace one by one.
[You have acquired the modifier syllable 'jeong.']
[You have acquired the modifier syllable 'yok.']
[You have acquired the modifier syllable 'gwa.']
[You have acquired the modifier syllable 'gyeok.']
When about half the syllables had passed over, Asmodeus spoke while looking at my modifier. More precisely, he was probably looking at the [won] in it.
[Seen up close, it really is a tempting modifier.]
I hid my modifier necklace beneath my clothes and spoke.
“Instead of trying to kill Michael, just take one block from him. You can manage that much, can't you?”
[One block······ Do you mean this?]
For an instant, I saw the necklace held in his one uninjured hand.
[Hunter of Grudges].
His 'target necklace,' now containing every block, shone brilliantly.
[The Demon King 'Devil of Lust and Wrath' has fulfilled the scenario clear conditions!]
[Scenario transfer begins.]
Reflexively, I checked my own modifier necklace.
[Demon King of Salvation].
In other words, that was not my [won].
[I knew the moment Michael fell into corruption. This was a trap.]
······Could he really have done it in that brief interval?
Asmodeus's incarnation body was dissolving as the scenario transfer began.
[Did you really think I wouldn't prepare for something like this?]
From the start, Asmodeus had fought Michael intending to obtain only [won].
Belatedly, I reached toward him, but Asmodeus was already beyond my reach.
[Good luck, Demon King of Salvation. You, too, only need to collect 'one more block' now.]
Asmodeus's body vanished in a brilliant burst of light. All I had left were the modifier blocks he had left behind.
[Devil of Lust and Wrath — Korean blocks: jeong-yok-gwa gyeok-no-ui ma-□]
Damn it. Of all the blocks, it had to be 'sin'······.
I had underestimated Asmodeus badly.
I turned to find Anna Croft glaring at me.
“What you promised me―.”
“Shh.”
My finger went reflexively to my lips. Something was wrong. Only moments ago, the undergrowth had rung with agonized screams, but now it was far too quiet.
As though every living thing around us had perished.
The instant the nearby blades of grass stood on end, so did the fine hairs on my skin.
I shouted almost instinctively.
“Activate [Future Sight]!”
[Great Demon's Eyes], glowing red. Anna Croft grabbed me and began to run. After covering over a hundred meters in an instant, she looked back. I was looking at the same scene.
Kwoooooosh―!
An enormous explosion was erupting in the very place we had just occupied. A violet hemisphere, shaped like a barrier, crumpled in an instant, destroying everything inside.
[Judgement Field (Judgement field)].
A demon-annihilating power obtainable only through 'corruption.'
Anna Croft spoke in despair.
“There's too much noise! I can't see the future!”
“You don't need to read all of it. Just read Michael's attack patterns.”
“You still mean to fight? If we use that Let's Become a Stone Story or whatever it's called and run―”
“Didn't you just see him attack the stones too?”

From a crater wreathed in violet smoke, the archangel who would kill me was walking out. Michael's Story, triggered by the [Fruit of Good and Evil], dominated his entire body. The fallen archangel was already half out of his mind.
[De··· mon··· King ···of Salvation.]
A True Voice that chilled me even from a distance.
“······He really has lost his mind.”
“Damn it, you ruined everything!”
“Let's go with the second plan.”
“Second? You never told me about one!”
“Let's make one up n······.”
I couldn't finish what I was saying.
A fierce gale sent Anna Croft flying far away.
I saw Michael's huge body hurtling toward me from the distance at a terrifying speed.
[Activating 'Demon King Transformation'!]
With a cracking sound, my body began to change. Black wings and a Demon King's horns sprouting.
My Status, too, had grown stronger in accordance with the second generation's probability. Of course, meeting him with this much Status alone would get me killed for nothing.
[The attribute 'Scenario Interpreter' activates.]
But it was not I who would clash with him.
[The Giant Story 'Demon Realm's Spring' begins its story!]
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' begins its storytelling!]
It was the 'Stories' I had built up.
Kwooooom!
「Demon Realm's Spring」 in my left hand collided with Michael's left hand. Almost simultaneously, the torch's flame in [Unbreakable Faith] targeted Michael's body.
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' screams with delight!]
Startled, Michael twisted his body and retreated.

The power of a 'Giant Story' was incredible. Even allowing for the second generation's probability restrictions, to think I could stand against that monster. My training with Yoo Hoseong had not been in vain.
[The Story 'Evil That Destroys Evil' begins its storytelling!]
[The Giant Story 'Eden's Demon' begins its storytelling!]
But I was not the only one with powerful Stories.
Rrrrrumble!
Under the tremendous pressure pouring out from Michael, all my Stories began to groan. My Status was a little short of what I needed to face him head-on.
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' roars as if frustrated!]
I'm sorry. If I were a little stronger, you wouldn't have to endure this.
The fierce assault that followed hit me with such force that my insides seemed to turn upside down.
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' protects you.]
[The Giant Story 'Demon Realm's Spring' protects you.]
[The Story 'King of a Kingless World' protects you.]
[The Story 'One Who Opposes the Extraordinary' protects you.]
My Stories were taking his attacks in my place.
For a brief moment, thoughts flashed through my head.
What if I used [Hell of Eternity]?
What if I activated [Electrification] and [Way of the Wind] together?
What if I activated [Bookmark] and called on other characters?
None of those plans offered a clear way out.
Was that the only way after all?
I hadn't wanted to end up like that again.
As I retreated, vomiting a bucketful of blood, Michael strode toward me. Apparently deciding to finish me, he let a violet aura flow from one hand.
A violet hemispherical barrier formed around me. A stigma that could never be reversed once activated. [Judgement Field], the court that punished all Evil, was unfolding.
Apparently, I was to be executed by crushing (壓搾刑).
“······Michael.”
But did Michael know?
That I had been waiting all along for him to activate that stigma.
“No, ······the fallen angel 'Lucifer.'”
[The Demon King 'King of Corrupted Angels' dislikes that name!]
Lucifer was originally one of the figures who would bring the original <Great War of Saints and Demons> to ruin.
「No Evil in the world can defeat the 'King of Corrupted Angels.'」

An Evil that grew stronger when facing Evil. A monster that would ultimately devour all Evil. Even a high-ranking Demon King in the top ten could not kill him. Because when facing Evil, he became more powerful than any other being in the world.
「But what if his opponent is not 'Evil'?」
All great power came at a price.
Watching the Judgement Field close to within ten or so meters, I reached inside my clothes.
What I took out was a single apple.
<Eden>'s Star Relic Fruit, given to me by the 'Scribe of Heaven' just before <Gigantomachia>.
“Don't you miss the taste?”
Michael's eyes wavered violently.
He probably recognized this apple.
Because he, too, would have eaten it before.
“When an angel eats the [Fruit of Good and Evil], 'Demon King Transformation' occurs. But what happens when a 'Demon King' eats the 'Fruit of Good and Evil'?”
I saw the flustered Michael reach out hastily.
But it was already too late.
At the very instant [Judgement Field] crushed my body.
With a crunch, my teeth bit into the [Fruit of Good and Evil].
It is an old memory.
―Scribe, how long must I keep repeating this war? A war with no victor in the end······.
He cannot remember when he asked that question, or which time it was.
―Michael. Do not think too deeply.
In his memories, Metatron always did nothing but smile like that.
For hundreds of years, perhaps thousands.
Metatron had always been there with that same smile, for longer than Michael himself could remember.
―Concentrate on hating the Evil before you. That is your 'scenario.'
······My scenario.
How long have I been hunting demons?
Michael forgot his own birth long ago.
[The power of the 'Fruit of Good and Evil' runs wild.]
Memories are always inaccurate.
What comes to mind: the last words of the Demon Kings he killed.
―How lamentable, you pitiful apostle of <Eden>. Must you truly go this far?
The one who ruled the 21st Demon Realm.
―Wahahahaha! You are just like us! Metatron has finally gone mad!
The one who ruled the 9th Demon Realm.
―Which 'number' Michael are you?
The one who ruled the 4th Demon Realm.
Beyond the faces of Demon Kings whose names he has forgotten, he sees the fellow archangels who died at his side.
―Michael, come to your senses. Please······. This is wrong.
Angels and Demon Kings.
The fragmented faces soon scatter into tens of thousands of puzzle pieces, then form a single great image (狀) again.
Good and Evil, who have opposed each other for eons.
Metatron, who had endured all those years, was smiling with the same expression on his face as thousands of years before.
―Be careful of just one thing. When using this power, you must never······.
[The power of the 'Fruit of Good and Evil' runs wild!]
As his memories were swept away all at once, Michael was engulfed in terrible pain, as though his head were being torn apart bit by bit.
Aaaaaaaaah!
All the Good in the world was screaming.
The wild grass, the trees, the insects. Every kind of Good (善) dwelling in all things was steeped in sorrow, breaking into cries of grief.
[You have unleashed a lethal attack on a being aligned with Absolute Good!]
[The Story 'Evil That Destroys Evil' howls in anguish!]
[You have broken a taboo!]
[A dreadful penalty is imposed upon you!]
A bloodied gray angel was smiling at Michael.
The moment I bit into the [Fruit of Good and Evil], the world changed before my eyes.
[You have consumed the forbidden Star Relic Fruit.]
[You are a 'Demon King.']
[The power of the 'Fruit of Good and Evil' whispers the secret of 'Absolute Good' to you.]
Messages reaching my ears amid a tremendous storm of Magic Power.
[You have experienced every aspect of Good and Evil (善惡)!]
[You have accomplished an impossible feat!]
[You have gained the possibility of a new Story!]
[The <Star Stream> is astonished by your achievement.]
[The <Star Stream> is considering your second modifier.]
The senses of a constellation, which I had not felt for a long time since becoming a Demon King.
[Deactivating 'Demon King Transformation.']
[The <Star Stream> fully restores your constellation.]
I saw a star shining brilliantly in the pitch-black sky.
It was my star.
[Activating 'Angel Transformation.']
